The repurchase would remove approximately 31.4% of outstanding shares, but the preliminary count and total cost remain subject to confirmation.
The stated price sets the expected purchase level; the final price is still subject to confirmation.
Tendering shareholders may have only about 69.8% of eligible shares accepted, subject to the final count.
